subject: Re: Encord/Ikea - Follow Up
text:
Hi Alex,
Thank you for writing and I was going to write to you today as we had a discussion internally about Encord by keeping the scope of the current project and not in terms of future projects.
First of all, thank you for your time and effort invested in our recent discussion, including the proposal, MNDA draft, slides, and the insightful annotation and active learning demonstrations. It’s clear Encord excels in native video annotation capabilities, active learning, and model performance insights. These are real strengths, and we appreciate how well-suited Encord is for sophisticated annotation tasks, especially in large-scale video processing.
That said, after discussion with the team with current project scope in mind, we have decided that Encord isn’t the right fit for this project. While it offers extensive functionality for annotation and data workflows, our immediate priority is a more streamlined, end-to-end computer vision with more emphasis on deployment. This was a tough decision, especially given Encord's capabilities with video and annotation. We wanted to let you know promptly to avoid unnecessary delays.
We genuinely value the professionalism you've demonstrated and hope we may revisit opportunities with Encord in the future, perhaps in projects with more complex annotation or compliance needs.
Thank you again for your time and understanding. Wishing you and the Encord team continued success, and we look forward to possibly collaborating again when the need aligns.
Best regards,
Sreenath
